sites.reason: Parses the literal "<sha> missing" line that git cat-file --batch prints for an absent object; the SHA is hydrated by fetch or the read throws. It says nothing about migration or database-object state.

Prose in the #2152 Link-header parser comment: the word "missing" describes a missing < that makes parseLinkHeader throw. Documentation of fail-closed parsing, not a truth claim about a database object.
